milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must navigate to and visually observe the potted dead bush inside the sandstone shelter. The potted dead bush is at spawn-relative (5, 1, 7). max_distance=5 ensures the player is close enough to clearly see it (inside or at the entrance of the building), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are actually looking toward it, confirming visual identification rather than just passing nearby.

scene_description: A small desert outpost with two structures on a sand floor. A sandstone shelter (east side) contains the target potted dead bush on a table-like display alongside a crafting table and barrel. A cobblestone hut (west side) serves as a distractor with a chest and cat inside. Desert decorations (cactus, dead bush) add atmosphere.
task_text: Find the potted dead bush inside one of the buildings in this desert outpost.
design_notes: Potted dead bush at relative (~5, ~1, ~7) inside sandstone shelter. Entrance faces south at (~4-6, ~1-2, ~5) with air blocks. Cobblestone hut serves as distractor. Agent successfully found the potted dead bush within 14-15 steps in preview. The sand ground, cactus, and dead bush create a coherent desert theme.
